css: body{font-family:Georgia,'Times New Roman',serif;font-size:10.5pt;line-height:1.42;color:#111} h1{font-size:18pt} h2{font-size:13.5pt;border-bottom:1px solid #ccc;padding-bottom:3px;margin-top:18px} h3{font-size:11.5pt} table{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;font-size:9pt;margin:8px 0} th,td{border:1px solid #999;padding:3px 6px;text-align:left;vertical-align:top} th{background:#f0f0f0} code{background:#f2f2f2;padding:0 3px;font-size:9pt} blockquote{border-left:3px solid #bbb;margin:8px 0;padding:2px 10px;color:#333;background:#fafafa}
